title: A Botched Recording and Will AI Take My Job?
titleZh: 录音翻车与AI抢饭碗之问
description: Steven explains how yesterday's recording (and a steak) got ruined, plans this year's Halloween horror readings, and gives an update on his lifting plateau. Most of the episode covers a student's pointed office-hours questions about how he uses Claude, what AI costs him, whether AI will replace teachers, and why Canada won't extradite a Chinese corruption suspect.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Summary

sentences.zh: 10月21日，周三。
sentences.en: Wednesday, October 21.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文一开口就坦白：昨天有一块牛排烤过头了，昨天的录音也“烤焦”了。
sentences.en: Steven confesses right off the bat: yesterday he overcooked a steak, and yesterday's recording got "burnt" too.

sentences.zh: 接着，他聊到想让播客更聚焦，规划了今年的万圣节朗读，说起健身房的训练周期和停滞不前的举重成绩。
sentences.en: Then he talks about wanting to make the podcast more focused, plans this year's Halloween reading, and discusses his gym training cycle and his stalled weightlifting numbers.

sentences.zh: 本期大部分篇幅，讲的是一位学生在答疑时抛来的尖锐问题：他怎么用 Claude，每月为 AI 花多少钱，AI 会不会抢走他的饭碗，还有加拿大为什么不引渡一名被中国通缉的贪腐嫌疑人。
sentences.en: Most of this episode covers the pointed questions a student threw at him during a Q&A: how he uses Claude, how much he spends on AI each month, whether AI will take his job, and why Canada won't extradite a corruption suspect wanted by China.

sentences.zh: 昨天翻车的录音
sentences.en: Yesterday's recording mishap

sentences.zh: 昨天那期用的是备用音频，来自 iPhone 上的大疆麦克风。
sentences.en: Yesterday's episode used backup audio from a DJI microphone on an iPhone.

sentences.zh: 原来，他的舒尔 MV7 Plus 同时给 Logic 和 QuickTime 供音，信号一断，两份录音全军覆没。
sentences.en: It turns out his Shure MV7 Plus was feeding audio to both Logic and QuickTime at the same time, so when the signal dropped, both recordings were lost.

sentences.zh: Blackmagic 相机软件盖住了 Logic 的窗口，他直到晚饭前才发现，那时音频已经“满是杂音”。
sentences.en: The Blackmagic camera software covered the Logic window, and he didn't notice until just before dinner, by which point the audio was already "full of noise."

sentences.zh: 改做视频播客后，流程复杂了不少，他现在真的需要两块屏幕。
sentences.en: Since switching to a video podcast, the workflow has gotten a lot more complicated, and he now really needs two screens.

sentences.zh: 牛排的惨剧也有了解释：录音时把牛排留在烤箱里，这就是代价。
sentences.en: The steak disaster has an explanation too: he left the steak in the oven while recording, and this was the price.

sentences.zh: 让播客更聚焦，以及万圣节朗读
sentences.en: Making the podcast more focused, plus Halloween readings

sentences.zh: 史蒂文觉得，昨天的开场白没拿捏好。
sentences.en: Steven felt he didn't get yesterday's opening quite right.

sentences.zh: 他改用偏学术的语气，结果不太对味。
sentences.en: He switched to a more academic tone, and it didn't feel quite right.

sentences.zh: 有些“铁杆听众”或许觉得 44 分钟的节目是一种“考验”。
sentences.en: Some "die-hard listeners" might find a 44-minute episode a bit of an "ordeal."

sentences.zh: 他说，并不指望谁把每期都听完，划船、举铁、散步、坐地铁时，让节目陪着你就好。
sentences.en: He says he doesn't expect anyone to listen to every episode in full; just let the show keep you company while you row, lift weights, take a walk or ride the subway.

sentences.zh: 下周的万圣节特辑，延续他每年的恐怖故事朗读。
sentences.en: Next week's Halloween special continues his yearly tradition of reading horror stories.

sentences.zh: 往年读过《黑猫》《猴爪》，还有《聊斋》里的故事。
sentences.en: In past years he has read "The Black Cat," "The Monkey's Paw," and stories from Liaozhai.

sentences.zh: 《聊斋》是一部讲鬼怪、精灵和狐仙的中国古典小说集。
sentences.en: Liaozhai is a classical Chinese story collection about ghosts, spirits and fox fairies.

sentences.zh: 他说，中国民间传说里的狐狸，有点像西方的狼人：白狐，或者一身白衣的女子，十有八九是妖精。
sentences.en: He says the fox in Chinese folklore is a bit like the Western werewolf: a white fox, or a woman dressed all in white, is almost certainly a demon.

sentences.zh: 接下来的打算：
sentences.en: What's planned next:

sentences.zh: 做成上下两集的万圣节特辑，提前录好，免得手忙脚乱
sentences.en: Make the Halloween special a two-part episode and record it in advance to avoid a last-minute scramble

sentences.zh: 选读《德古拉》或《弗兰肯斯坦》的片段
sentences.en: Read excerpts from Dracula or Frankenstein

sentences.zh: 为圣诞节和复活节各准备一篇朗读，再加上每年 11 月 11 日的《在佛兰德斯战场》
sentences.en: Prepare one reading each for Christmas and Easter, plus "In Flanders Fields" every November 11

sentences.zh: 在网站上建一个下载页，收齐往期朗读
sentences.en: Set up a download page on the website collecting all past readings

sentences.zh: 为什么不让 AI 来读？
sentences.en: Why not let AI do the reading?

sentences.zh: “有时候自己动手，比费劲调教 AI 更省事。”
sentences.en: "Sometimes doing it yourself is easier than struggling to coax the AI into it."

sentences.zh: 中文学习与对学生的羡慕
sentences.en: Studying Chinese, and envying students

sentences.zh: 目前他读的是一本中文杂志和雷军的自传。
sentences.en: Right now he is reading a Chinese magazine and Lei Jun's autobiography.

sentences.zh: 他常对学生说，羡慕他们每天能学六七个小时英语。
sentences.en: He often tells his students he envies them for being able to study English six or seven hours a day.

sentences.zh: 可一旦学习成了“你的生活和工作”，每一天都有同样的压力。
sentences.en: But once studying becomes "your life and your work," every single day carries the same pressure.

sentences.zh: 健身房与跑步难题
sentences.en: The Gym and the Running Problem

sentences.zh: “刚练完，结果被困在健身房里了。”
sentences.en: "I'd just finished working out, and then I got stuck inside the gym."

sentences.zh: 他把账算在健身房的二维码入场系统头上。
sentences.en: He blamed it on the gym's QR-code entry system.

sentences.zh: 他差点把训练往后推，可“待会儿再说”通常等于不了了之。
sentences.en: He almost put off his workout, but "I'll do it later" usually means it never happens.

sentences.zh: 周末下过雨，北京转凉，他的跑步也荒废了。
sentences.en: It rained over the weekend, Beijing turned cool, and his running fell by the wayside too.

sentences.zh: 他还发现，所住大楼的地下室里居然有个室内单车俱乐部：“这些大楼总能让我大吃一惊。”
sentences.en: He also discovered that there was actually an indoor cycling club in the basement of his building: "These buildings never stop surprising me."

sentences.zh: 训练周期、举重成绩和肌酸
sentences.en: Training cycles, lifting numbers, and creatine

sentences.zh: 史蒂文大约六周一个周期：五周高强度，一周减量，然后开启新周期或休息一周。
sentences.en: Steven works in cycles of about six weeks: five weeks of high intensity, one week of deloading, then he starts a new cycle or takes a week off.

sentences.zh: 他九月中旬回归，第一个周期快结束了。
sentences.en: He came back in mid-September, and his first cycle is almost over.

sentences.zh: 今天练的是标准的 StrongLifts 5×5：
sentences.en: Today's workout was the standard StrongLifts 5×5:

sentences.zh: 深蹲：80 公斤，再加重姿势就会变形
sentences.en: Squat: 80 kg; any heavier and his form breaks down

sentences.zh: 杠铃划船：约 70 公斤
sentences.en: Barbell row: about 70 kg

sentences.zh: 肩推：卡在 45 公斤左右
sentences.en: Overhead press: stuck at around 45 kg

sentences.zh: 硬拉：上周 125 公斤
sentences.en: Deadlift: 125 kg last week

sentences.zh: 卧推：约 75 公斤
sentences.en: Bench press: about 75 kg

sentences.zh: 肌酸帮他长肌肉，体重也涨到了 80 多公斤。
sentences.en: Creatine has helped him build muscle, and his body weight has gone up to over 80 kg.

sentences.zh: 他宁愿保持标准姿势，也不想“为了多挂几片杠铃片而堆重量”。
sentences.en: He'd rather keep good form than "pile on weight just to load a few more plates."

sentences.zh: ‍ 物联网专业的课
sentences.en: ‍ An IoT major class

sentences.zh: 周三是他的坐班日，上午有一节物联网专业的课。
sentences.en: Wednesday is his office-hours day, and in the morning he has a class for the IoT major.

sentences.zh: 这一届被分成两个班，他这个班只有两个女生，另一个班却有七个。
sentences.en: This year's cohort is split into two classes; his class has only two female students, while the other has seven.

sentences.zh: 女生们说自己被“和同类隔开了”，不少男生则说太紧张，不敢跟她们搭话。
sentences.en: The girls say they've been "separated from their own kind," while many boys say they're too nervous to dare talk to them.

sentences.zh: 这些学生才刚离开高中三个月，很难不把他们称作“孩子”。
sentences.en: These students left high school only three months ago, so it's hard not to call them "kids."

sentences.zh: 因为他让每个人都参与，两个女生被点到的次数很多，有时让她们有点烦。
sentences.en: Because he has everyone participate, the two girls get called on a lot, which sometimes annoys them a bit.

sentences.zh: 没人举手时，他就随机配对，但会避开尴尬的组合。
sentences.en: When no one raises a hand, he pairs students up randomly, but avoids awkward combinations.

sentences.zh: 答疑时间：Claude、价格与提示词
sentences.en: Q&A time: Claude, prices and prompts

sentences.zh: 一位学生来答疑，问的像是面试题。
sentences.en: A student came to the Q&A, and the questions sounded like job interview questions.

sentences.zh: 第一个问题：他怎么用 Claude？
sentences.en: First question: how does he use Claude?

sentences.zh: 毕竟中国的学生用不了。
sentences.en: After all, students in China can't use it.

sentences.zh: 课堂上他只提中国的模型：DeepSeek、豆包和 Kimi。
sentences.en: In class he only mentions Chinese models: DeepSeek, Doubao and Kimi.

sentences.zh: 他在终端里用 Claude，ChatGPT 和 Claude 合计每月约 60 美元。
sentences.en: He uses Claude in the terminal, and ChatGPT and Claude together cost about 60 US dollars a month.

sentences.zh: 他还发现，DeepSeek 做不了 PPT，豆包免费版每月只能做一份。
sentences.en: He also found that DeepSeek can't make PowerPoints, and Doubao's free version can only make one a month.

sentences.zh: 他鼓励学生用 AI 学词汇、语法、讲解作文，但要求它“只给一屏手机的信息量”。
sentences.en: He encourages students to use AI to learn vocabulary and grammar and to explain their essays, but he tells it to "only give one phone screen's worth of information."

sentences.zh: 他打算 2 月退订 Descript，因为现在靠 Claude 就能转写、清理文稿、剪片段：“太惊艳了。”
sentences.en: He plans to cancel Descript in February, because now Claude alone can transcribe, clean up transcripts and cut clips: "It's amazing."

sentences.zh: AI 会抢走他的工作吗？引渡之问
sentences.en: Will AI take his job? The extradition question

sentences.zh: AI 会取代他吗？
sentences.en: Will AI replace him?

sentences.zh: “AI 不可能取代老师。为什么？因为教学本身在变。”
sentences.en: "AI can't replace teachers. Why? Because teaching itself is changing."

sentences.zh: 老师曾经用黑板，如今没人怀念。
sentences.en: Teachers used to use blackboards, and nobody misses them now.

sentences.zh: 语法讲解、词汇表、作业准备，AI 想拿就拿去：“让它拿吧。”
sentences.en: Grammar explanations, vocabulary lists, homework prep — if AI wants them, it can take them: "Let it."

sentences.zh: 课堂时间则留给口语和演讲。
sentences.en: Class time, meanwhile, is reserved for speaking and presentations.

sentences.zh: 最后一个问题让他始料未及：加拿大为什么替美国逮捕了华为的孟晚舟，却不肯把一名被指贪腐的中国人送回中国？
sentences.en: The last question caught him off guard: why did Canada arrest Huawei's Meng Wanzhou on behalf of the US, yet refuse to send a Chinese person accused of corruption back to China?

sentences.zh: 他当场上网搜，没认出是哪起案子。
sentences.en: He searched online on the spot but couldn't identify which case it was.

sentences.zh: 据他了解，加中之间没有引渡条约。
sentences.en: As far as he knew, Canada and China have no extradition treaty.

sentences.zh: 他为没能给出更好的答案道了歉，并称这是教英语生活的一部分，“在各种比喻意义上躲子弹”。
sentences.en: He apologized for not giving a better answer, and said this is part of life teaching English: "dodging bullets in every metaphorical sense."

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's Summary

sentences.zh: 从失灵的麦克风，到卡住的举重，再到猝不及防的提问，史蒂文总能笑着应对挫折。
sentences.en: From a broken microphone, to a stalled lift, to questions that caught him off guard, Steven always faces setbacks with a smile.

sentences.zh: 他希望 AI 接手教学中枯燥的部分，把课堂时间留给人与人的交流。
sentences.en: He hopes AI will take over the tedious parts of teaching, leaving class time for human-to-human interaction.

vocab.en: to go wrong / flop (lit. "to flip a car")
to answer students' questions; office hours
to be in a flurry, rushed and flustered
to end with nothing done, fizzle out
